title: Three different delivery fees
evidence: Terms: '20 SAR per order'. FAQ: 10 SAR under 200 SAR, free above. Social and brand pages: 'free shipping to all cities'.
fix: Publish one delivery fee rule and show it in the header bar, on every product page and in the cart before sign-in.

title: Delivery time ranges from same-day to 10 working days
evidence: PC Gaming listing: same-day Riyadh. Product pages: 'Riyadh within 24 hours'. FAQ: '3 to 7 days'. Terms: Riyadh '3 to 7 working days', elsewhere '7 to 10'.
fix: One promise per city, shown as a date ('Arrives Thu 24 Oct') with an order-by cut-off, driven by one setting.

title: Same product, different prices across pages and languages
evidence: Lenovo LOQ 15IRX10 (83JE01BWAD): 6,899 SAR on /en/, 5,299 SAR on /ar/. i5-14400F + RTX 5060 PC: 6,999 / 5,599 / 5,299 / 3,999 on four pages. Samsung OLED G6: 3,399 / 3,099 / 2,799.
fix: Single price source for both store views, cache purge on price change, a daily automated price-parity check.

title: No guest checkout; account and SMS code required before buying
evidence: FAQ: 'You have to be a registered user to be able to make purchases'. Sign-up sends a 4-digit SMS code.
fix: Guest checkout with phone number; verify by OTP at payment; offer 'save your details' after the order is placed.

title: Price typo: 16,449 SAR on a listing for a 6,299 SAR laptop
evidence: Lenovo Legion 5 i7-14650HX/16GB/512GB listed at 'Special Price 16449 Regular Price 16999'; its own page says 6,299.
fix: Add a price sanity rule (flag any special price more than 2x or under 0.5x the category median) before publish.

title: Returns are 7 days, defects only, with exclusions and fees
evidence: 'within (7) days', defects or wrong items only; excludes 'all computer accessories'; 'no return is made on any request in installments'; 59 SAR (Terms) or 79 SAR (Returns page) fee. The E-Commerce Law gives a 7-day cancellation right for unused items: legal review advised.
fix: 14-day change-of-mind for sealed items, plain-language exceptions, one fee, an online returns form; legal check against the E-Commerce Law.

title: Refund time stated as 1–5 days and 3–30 days
evidence: Payment page: '1 to 5 business days'. Terms: 'from 3 days to 30 days'.
fix: One refund SLA per payment method in a single table.

title: Legal and warranty pages read as raw machine translation
evidence: 'All electronic devices from Technology gold have been guaranteed…'; 'Accessories and accessories maybe have guaranteed…'; company named four different ways.
heuristic: Match between system and real world
fix: Professional bilingual rewrite of all policy pages, Arabic as source, plain-language summaries on top.

title: Warranty page says the store is not responsible
evidence: '…provided by the agent are not considered the responsibility of The Golden Technology. The customer must contact directly with the agent.' 79 SAR courier fee for remote areas.
heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
fix: Store-owned warranty concierge: Golden Tech opens and tracks the claim with the brand agent for the customer.

title: Instalment messages conflict and the payment page omits them
evidence: Product pages say '4 interest-free payments' on some items and '4 payments … includes fees' on others. Tabby, Tamara, MISpay and Amwal appear on social posts, not on the Payment Methods page.
fix: One instalment widget ('from SAR X/month, 0% with Tabby') on cards, product page and cart; list every provider on the payment page.

title: No Apple Pay or STC Pay found
evidence: Payment Methods page lists Visa, Mastercard, mada and card instalments only.
fix: Enable Apple Pay (and STC Pay) through the gateway; show express pay on the product page and cart.

title: Cash-on-delivery fee disclosed only in the Terms
evidence: Terms: COD carries 'an additional 20 riyals'. FAQ lists showroom cash, not COD.
fix: Show the COD fee next to the option in checkout and in the delivery policy.

title: Showroom pickup mentioned but not offered as a delivery option
evidence: FAQ mentions 'Click and Collect'; no pickup method was found in checkout evidence. eXtra and Jarir offer free pickup.
fix: Free 'Collect from Olaya in 2 hours' option for Riyadh, with stock shown per location.

title: Google Ads clicks land on the homepage
evidence: Ad click URL /?gad_source=1&gclid=… opens the homepage; the ad-parameter URL is also indexed by Google.
heuristic: Match between system and real world
fix: Intent-matched landing pages per campaign (gaming laptops, MacBook, PC builds) and canonical tags that strip ad parameters.

title: Eight competing offer pages, two with the same title
evidence: /offers.html and /laptops-computers-and-gaming-monitors-offers.html share a title; /mega-sale.html is titled 'Special Offers' and holds 'Back To School' content.
fix: One Offers hub with campaign tabs and filters; retire or redirect the rest.

title: Weak deal framing
evidence: Deal of the day at -4% (MacBook Pro 14 M5, 9,499 vs 9,899); banner copy 'Discount till 61%'.
heuristic: Match between system and real world
fix: Rotate deals with meaningful savings; native copy ('Up to 61% off').

title: Navigation is by brand, not by need
evidence: Laptops split into brand pages and gaming/business/2-in-1. No student, creator or 'under 3,000 SAR' paths.
fix: Card sort and tree test with Saudi shoppers; add 'Shop by need' (Study, Gaming, Work, Create) and price bands.

title: Category labels don't match contents; duplicate and dead-end paths
evidence: 'Gaming' is titled for computers and laptops but lists peripherals. Servers holds one product. /ar/laptop/microsoft and /ar/microsoft/laptop both exist.
fix: Rename and merge categories; one canonical path each; fold single-product categories.

title: Specs are separate pages instead of combinable filters
evidence: Refresh rate, resolution and panel type are category pages (/240hz, /oled, /4k), so '240Hz + OLED + 27"' can't be combined. Price filter buckets: 0–10,000 and 10,000–20,000.
fix: Faceted filters for CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, size, refresh rate and panel, with a price slider; keep SEO landing pages as presets.

title: No price sort on listings
evidence: Sort options found: Position, Best Sellers, Most Viewed, wishlist count.
fix: Add 'Price low to high / high to low', 'Newest' and 'Top rated'.

title: Product titles are 115–140 character spec dumps
evidence: 'Laptop Asus ROG Strix G614PR Gaming AMD Ryzen 9-8940HX Processor, 32GB Ram, 1TB SSD M.2, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti 12GB,16-inch Display'. Typos such as '512GB SDD'.
fix: Title schema 'Brand Model' plus 4 spec chips (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage) on cards.

title: Almost no customer reviews
evidence: Reviews exist but show 0–2 per product (e.g. '1 review', '2 reviews').
fix: Post-delivery review request over WhatsApp/SMS; show store rating from Google (4.5+) site-wide.

title: No dated ETA, trade-in, protection plan or accessory cross-sell
evidence: Not found on any sampled product page. Amazon.sa shows dated delivery; Jarir offers trade-in; Microless offers extended warranty.
fix: Delivery date block, 'Complete your setup' bundle (bag, mouse, Office), extended warranty add-on.

title: Spec errors in titles and URLs
evidence: Samsung G90XF title says 4K, description says FHD 1920x1080. A 15IRX10 product lives at a 15IRX9 URL. Arabic title breaks 'i7-13645HX' into '13645HX-7'.
fix: Spec attributes as structured data validated against the brand feed; titles generated from attributes.

title: Test and demo pages are public and indexed
evidence: /en/home-page-02-66d465ea485bb ('Golden EN Home Page Demo') and /en/category-test.html ('Category Test') are live.
fix: Unpublish or noindex; add a pre-release QA checklist.

title: Search results and ad-parameter URLs are indexed
evidence: /en/catalogsearch/result/?amnoroute=&q=… and /?gad_source=1 appear in Google; a retired product URL lands on search results showing other models.
fix: Noindex search results; 301 retired products to their successor; canonical tags.

title: English and Arabic store views bleed into each other
evidence: Arabic titles indexed on /en/ URLs; Arabic blog posts under /en/blog/; page titles 'FAQ EN' and 'FAQs AR'; 'Asus' vs 'اسوس', 'قيمنق'.
fix: Fix hreflang and canonicals per store view; Arabic terminology glossary; customer-facing page titles.

title: Broken English in titles and meta copy
evidence: 'Shop best Gaming laptop with in KSA'; 'Now can get your Laptop…'; 'Shop Now Laptop Gaming, PC Gaming & Monitors Gaming'; 'had established'.
heuristic: Match between system and real world
fix: Rewrite title and meta templates in native English and Arabic.

title: No e-commerce authentication badge found; entity name differs
evidence: No Saudi Business Center / Maroof badge found. Terms say 'Golden Technology foundation'; About says 'Trading Company'. Authorised-reseller claim names no brand.
fix: Show the SBC e-commerce certificate, CR and VAT in the footer; one legal entity name; brand-authorisation badges.

title: No WhatsApp or live chat; contact details differ by page
evidence: No WhatsApp link on site. Landline hours 9:30am–10pm on one page, 8am–5pm on another. Two emails (info@, online@).
fix: WhatsApp Business with catalogue and order updates; one contact page with hours per channel.

title: No order tracking or self-service cancellation found
evidence: Cancellation by phone only; 59 SAR fee after shipping. No order-tracking page found.
fix: Order status page and proactive SMS/WhatsApp updates; cancel button until dispatch.

title: No business or quote path despite a wholesale arm
evidence: About page: wholesale division. No corporate sales, RFQ or quote page found.
fix: 'Business' hub: request a quote, bulk pricing, VAT invoice, bank transfer / PO.

title: No PC configurator
evidence: PC Gaming sold only as pre-builts grouped by Intel tier. Newegg KSA, FEEH and GCC Gamers offer builders; eXtra, Jarir, Amazon and noon do not.
fix: Guided PC builder with compatibility checks, FPS estimates and instalment price.

title: Outdated models and duplicate product pages still listed
evidence: M3 MacBook Air, Surface Pro 8 (Windows 10) indexed. ROG Strix G614PR has two product URLs.
fix: Retire or redirect old SKUs; merge duplicates.

title: Price box repeats the same message four ways
evidence: 'Special Price 2299 Regular Price 2499 -8% Tax included Save 200'.
fix: One price, one struck-through was-price, one saving chip; 'VAT included' as a caption.

title: Stock Magento microcopy and formatting
evidence: '91items', 'Set Descending Direction', 'find just the label you're looking for', 'Wish List Compare'.
heuristic: Match between system and real world
fix: Microcopy pass across components in both languages.

title: New Saudi Riyal symbol not used; currency missing on English prices
evidence: Arabic shows 'ر.س'; English snippets show bare numbers with 'Tax included'.
fix: Adopt the official Riyal symbol in both languages with a text fallback.

title: Loyalty programme is thin
evidence: 1,000 points = 10 SAR; validity period unstated; can end 'without prior notice'.
fix: Tie points to accessories, setup and warranty perks; state the expiry.

title: No National Address (short address) field found
evidence: Since 1 Jan 2026 carriers must reject parcels without a valid National Address. No short-address field or lookup was found in checkout evidence.
fix: Short Address field (4 letters + 4 digits) with format check, lookup autofill and a 'find my short address' link.
